integrity: The proof derives a rank-dependent singular spectrum analytically from the source reduced-augmented matrix, and gives an exact 2x3 integer LP witness. The checker uses exact fractional arithmetic for the finite witness and is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The spectral dichotomy requires a strictly complementary central-path limit, b nonzero, full-row-rank integer LP constraints, strict primal-dual feasibility, and the prescribed fixed scalar preconditioner. It does not bound all possible preconditioners, algorithmic query complexity, or finite-gap iterations away from the asymptotic central path.
title: Rank-controlled sharpness of a quantum interior-point preconditioner
